# SlainteTech

> Healthcare workflow, patient safety, hospital billing recovery, and EU NIS2 cybersecurity software built on HL7 FHIR R4. SlainteTech separates fast clinician documentation from tested, deterministic Python safety gates (:8081) and tamper-proof FHIR R4 audit logging (:8082), connecting alongside Epic, Cerner, or MEDITECH in 15 minutes via SMART-on-FHIR v2 or running stand-alone in private cloud and offline environments.

Full technical specification & FAQ reference: https://slainte-tech.com/llms-full.txt
Sitemap: https://slainte-tech.com/sitemap.xml
Contact & 30-Day Pilot Booking: hello@slainte-tech.com

## Core Pages
- [Home & Platform Overview](https://slainte-tech.com/): Rule-based clinical safety, EU NIS2 cybersecurity, and fast frontline charting on one HL7 FHIR R4 core.
- [Platform & Safety Architecture](https://slainte-tech.com/platform/): Four-layer architecture separating HTMX frontline screens (:8000), 16 modules, FastMCP Python safety gates (:8081), and SlainteFHIR R4 (:8082).
- [Security, GDPR Art. 9 & NIS2 Compliance](https://slainte-tech.com/security-compliance/): Built-in EU NIS2 Article 21 safeguards, GDPR Article 9 redaction, DCB0129/0160 engineering, OASIS SARIF v2.1.0 outputs, and offline execution.
- [Commercial Pricing & Licensing](https://slainte-tech.com/pricing/): Clinic Edition (€12,000-€15,000/yr), Hospital Security & Coding Sidecar (€48,000-€95,000/yr with typical <90-day HIPE DRG payback), and Enterprise VPC / Offline deployment.
- [Investors & Strategic Rationale](https://slainte-tech.com/investors/): Defensibility thesis built on deterministic clinical safety, 15-minute SMART-on-FHIR v2 hospital entry, and 8 verticals on one codebase.
- [Integration & API Documentation](https://slainte-tech.com/docs/): SMART-on-FHIR v2 PKCE S256 launch, HL7v2 ADT/ORU/RDE pipe-hat ingestion, OIDC SSO, and HMAC SIEM webhooks.
- [About SlainteTech](https://slainte-tech.com/about/): Irish healthcare interoperability and security engineering team focused on measurable patient safety.
- [Book a 30-Day Pilot](https://slainte-tech.com/contact/): Start a zero-disruption read-only hospital audit, clinic walkthrough, or investor briefing.

## Eight Healthcare Verticals
- [For Emergency Departments (SlainteED)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/emergency-departments/): Manchester Triage Cat 1-5 queue, RCP NEWS2 sepsis tracking, ambulance pre-alert handover, and 3-tier prescribing checks.
- [For General Practitioners & Community Nursing (SlainteGP)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/general-practice/): Fast house-call and surgery notes, chronic disease recalls, kidney-checked prescriptions, and monthly HSE GMS claims export.
- [For Psychiatrists & Mental Health (SlaintePsych)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/psychiatry/): Calm sensory workspace, PHQ-9 and GAD-7 longitudinal tracking, psychotropic drug checks, and locked sensitive notes.
- [For Dental Surgeons & DSOs (SlainteDent)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/dentistry/): Interactive 32-tooth FDI odontogram, 6-sextant BPE gum charting, bleeding/allergy banners, and safe post-op prescribing.
- [For Clinical & Community Pharmacies (SlaintePharm)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/pharmacy/): Risk-sorted dispensing queue flagging allergy, high-alert drug pairs, and renal holds plus clean monthly HSE PCRS exports.
- [For Ambulance & Paramedic Services (SlainteEMS)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/ambulance-ems/): Large glove-friendly 44px tablet ePCR, offline vital scoring, and 1-tap hospital emergency bay pre-alert.
- [For Elite Sports Clubs & Federations (SlainteSport)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/sports-medicine/): Squad medical readiness, SCAT6 concussion return-to-play clearance logs, TUE checks, and athlete privacy locks.
- [For Astronaut & Aerospace Medicine (SlainteAstro)](https://slainte-tech.com/verticals/astronaut-health/): 100% air-gapped onboard medical station with offline clinical safety rules, zero external dependency, and capsule vitals tracking.

## Sixteen Clinical, Billing & Security Modules
- [Agents & Modules Directory](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/): Filterable catalog across Security (SlainteShield), Governance & Coding (SlainteGov), and Clinical Care (SlainteClinical).
- [Modules Visual Gallery](https://slainte-tech.com/agents/): All 16 clinical, coding, and cybersecurity modules with live dashboard screenshots.
- [SlainteShield-BOLA (Patient Chart Access & Role-Boundary Testing)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/bola-authorization-red-team-agent/): Automated cross-patient boundary probes and SSRF egress tests.
- [SlainteShield-FHIR (HL7 FHIR R4 & Medical Coding Conformance)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/fhir-r4-conformance-terminology-agent/): HL7 FHIR R4 validation and SNOMED CT / LOINC / ICD-10 terminology auditing in SARIF format.
- [SlainteShield-CVE (Software Supply-Chain & Single Sign-On Security)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/healthcare-cve-vulnerability-agent/): Software dependency, hash lock, and hospital single sign-on security checks.
- [SlainteGov-GDPR (GDPR Patient Privacy & Emergency Access Gate)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/gdpr-clinical-privacy-deidentification-agent/): Automatic patient PII redaction and dual-logged break-glass emergency access.
- [SlainteGov-Audit (Tamper-Proof Clinical Audit Ledger)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/immutable-clinical-ai-audit-agent/): Append-only SQLite provenance ledger with delete/update blocking triggers and SHA-256 signing.
- [SlainteRev-Coding (HIPE, ICD-10-AM & DRG Revenue Recovery)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/autonomous-icd10-drg-clinical-coding-agent/): Surfaces under-coded inpatient complexity (CC/MCC) from lab and clinical evidence before billing close.
- [SlainteGov-Onboard (Clinic Onboarding & Legacy Data Migration)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/clinic-onboarding-legacy-migration-agent/): Imports legacy clinic CSV/XML records into standardized FHIR R4 charts with pre-commit checks.
- [SlainteGov-NIS2 (EU NIS2 Directive & Hospital Cyber Audit)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/eu-nis2-directive-compliance-agent/): Live Article 21 control testing, SOC webhooks, and printable executive compliance certificates.
- [SlainteEngine-Ingest (Legacy Hospital Feed & Document Intake Bridge)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/multimodal-hl7v2-fhir-ingestion-agent/): Converts HL7v2 ADT/ORU/RDE feeds, PDFs, and spreadsheets into deduplicated FHIR R4 patient bundles.
- [SlainteScribe-Brief (Source-Cited Shift Handover Briefing)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/cited-patient-handover-summariser-agent/): Grounded clinical shift briefs with clickable chart citations and zero invented patient facts.
- [SlainteRx-Guard (3-Tier Allergy, Drug-Clash & Kidney Prescribing Gate)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/pharmacotherapy-allergy-renal-safety-agent/): Tier 1 cross-allergy class blocks, Tier 2 ISMP high-alert DDI rules, Tier 3 LOINC eGFR & Potassium renal gating.
- [SlainteDx-Triage (Manchester Triage & NEWS2 Sepsis Early Warning)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/manchester-triage-news2-acuity-agent/): Exact Python calculation of RCP NEWS2 (0-20) and Manchester Triage Categories 1-5 in under 10ms.
- [SlainteScribe-Voice (Consultation Scribe & Pre-Screened Order Drafter)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/ambient-clinical-voice-scribe-agent/): Drafts structured SOAP notes and pre-screened orders requiring mandatory clinician sign-off.
- [SlainteCare-Transfer (Safe Discharge & Medication Reconciliation)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/discharge-clinical-handover-agent/): Verifies stability trends, reconciled medications, and signed GP discharge letters before exit.
- [SlainteEMS-Alert (Ambulance-to-ED Pre-Arrival Alert)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/emergency-prehospital-prealert-agent/): Transmits structured pre-hospital vitals and acuity bundles straight to receiving resuscitation bays.
- [SlainteCare-CDM (Chronic Disease Care-Gap & Recall Tracker)](https://slainte-tech.com/health-tech-agents/chronic-disease-surveillance-agent/): Tracks hypertension, diabetes HbA1c, and kidney eGFR surveillance gaps for structured GP CDM contracts.
